//: How many roster slots each position gets when a blank template is written
MEASURED, NOT AUTHORED: the league mean across the 138 teams x 85 players
of a base save, apportioned to exactly 85 by largest remainder. A CFB27
team always carries exactly 85, so the skeleton has to as well.
This only shapes the BLANK template. Nothing forces a filled roster to
match it -- put whoever you like at whatever position, and slots you do
not fill are still completed as end-of-roster depth.
